topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, tumor progression model, and the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Growth signal independence and oncogenic signaling cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream signaling pathways drive growth factor independence and cell survival.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how differentiation blocks halt terminal maturation and sustain proliferative states in hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the regulatory pathways and balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins that cancer cells alter to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and genome protection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover telomere dynamics, mechanisms of senescence bypass, and the role of p53 in responding to cellular stress.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the Warburg effect, widespread metabolic rewiring, and the epigenetic impact of metabolic enzyme mutations in cancer.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the angiogenic switch and blood vessel recruitment required to supply expanding tumors with oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and secondary tumor biology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, dissemination pathways, liquid biopsy tracking, and genomic characteristics of metastases.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with a recap of cancer hallmarks and closing remarks.
